footer.tagline: Share a link and collect candid, anonymous messages from anyone.

home.heroTitle2: to your face — they'll send it here.
home.heroBody: Constructive feedback is what moves personal and professional life forward — yet people hesitate to give honest or critical feedback, held back by fear of damaging a relationship or by plain awkwardness. So the truth we most need to hear often stays invisible.
home.heroBody2: FeedbackBox removes that mental block by collecting opinions in a fully anonymous, secured way. The honest words people won't say in their own name reach your private inbox through a single shareable link.
home.mockSample: Your talks last week genuinely changed how our team ships. Thank you for being so generous with your time.

steps.title: Claim your box
steps.body: Sign up in under a minute and we generate a unique /u/you link for you.

steps.title: Share the link
steps.body: Drop it in your bio, email signature, or on a slide. No app to install.

steps.title: Read the truth
steps.body: Anonymous messages land in your private dashboard, timestamped and unread-marked.

features.title: Anonymous by design
features.body: Senders never log in. Messages arrive with zero identity attached.

features.title: One shareable link
features.body: A single public URL collects candid feedback from friends or an audience.

features.title: Owner-only inbox
features.body: Only you can read what is sent to you. Nothing is public by default.

features.title: Open source
features.body: Self-hostable and MIT licensed, built on a clean Next.js plus Postgres stack.

privacy.title: What's sent here stays here — protected
privacy.subtitle: Concerned about privacy? Fair. Here's exactly how the box keeps your messages safe, and why no one else can ever read them.

points.title: No sender identity, ever
points.body: Leaving a message needs no account, no name, no email — and nothing about who sent it is stored. There is simply no sender record to expose.

points.title: Only you can open your box
points.body: Every read request is checked against the logged-in owner's own session at the data layer. There is no admin panel and no public listing — the only key to your inbox is your own login.

points.title: Your call — delete anytime
points.body: Read, mark unread, or permanently delete any message from your dashboard. Deleted messages are removed from the system immediately — no archive, no hidden copies.

points.title: No tracking. No data selling. Open code.
points.body: The app uses no tracking cookies, ads, or analytics — and the entire source code is public, so anyone can audit how it treats your data.
